items.what: The renderer restates PanelTopTabButtonTemplate's bottom anchor as a fixed ty + 4 (also on the next two draw lines); runtime BEHAVIOUR BUG in the mock, not the addon
items.why: Native OnLoad (SharedUIPanelTemplates.lua, PanelTopTabButtonMixin:OnLoad) anchors Left/Right/Active art BOTTOMLEFT/BOTTOMRIGHT at y 0 with height scaled to 75 percent. Atlas heights are 36 (inactive) and 42 (active), so art is 27 and 31.5 high and its top is at the content top minus those heights: ry+1 and ry-3.5. The mock draws both at ry+4, so inactive art ends 3 units and the selected tab 7.5 units below the content top, over the detail frame's top edge, while the labels (positioned from the button centre) are correct. Fix: derive the art y from ry + 28 - art.height.
items.reason: Independent verifier and native source cross-check confirmed the defect, corrected renderer geometry and removed redundant imports and commentary
